title: 기존 마커 ID를 적용한2D·3D 결과
recording_scope: Same synchronized eight-camera gait trial,22 lower-limb marker names
interpretation: Historical explicitly approved2D records are separated from new direct transfers and assistant-inferred assignments.
No interpolation or synthetic observations. Geometry rejects observations and never creates marker names.
Conditional heldout correctness and reprojection agreement do not establish overall anatomical accuracy.
